properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-19 for Mission Bay's third real-buildings pass (remaining uncovered footprints inside the official Mission Bay North/South redevelopment-area boundary): A residential condominium building at 335 Berry St, OSM-tagged as part of the Mission Walk complex. REPLACED 2026-10-12 (shape; status and use unchanged): the owner approved building records whose outline matches an Assessor lot at 85% or better, both ways, using the lot (CLAUDE.md, 'An official parcel beats our drawing'). DataSF's Assessor layer (data/raw/parcels.geojson) has Assessor lot 8707120 (2,696 m2, active, mapped 2010-01-11); the earlier outline of 1,878 m2 and the lot overlap with IoU 0.66 (97% of the earlier outline lies inside the lot and it covers 67% of the lot). The outline is now that lot using the lots' own vertices (no simplification). The lot is condominium-mapped: 67 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lot 8707120 and 66 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. geometry_type stays 'real'. Previous digitized_from: 'DataSF Building Footprints (mblr SF8707120); name/address from OpenStreetMap way 56656114 (335 Berry St)'. Previous accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- surveyed DataSF Building Footprints outline (mblr SF8707120), cross-referenced by position against an OpenStreetMap building/address point (way 56656114) for the name and street address; not a hand trace or plan estimate. Built 2009 per the DataSF Assessor (year_property_built) and San Francisco Condo Market; the unit count for 335 Berry alone is unsettled (Condo Market lists 39 units, while the 131 below-market-rate condos in SocketSite's 2008 post span both 330 and 335 Berry).'.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 8707120 (2,696 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. The lot is condominium-mapped: 67 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lot 8707120 and 66 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (DataSF Building Footprints (mblr SF8707120)); 97% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 67% of the lot.
properties.notes: Built 2009 per the DataSF Assessor (year_property_built) and San Francisco Condo Market; the unit count for 335 Berry alone is unsettled (Condo Market lists 39 units, while the 131 below-market-rate condos in SocketSite's 2008 post span both 330 and 335 Berry).
